# BlastClean

> Training for industrial cleaning crews: 40-hour HAZWOPER, gas detection, decontamination, PPE, spill response and the annual refresher, with guides to vacuum trucks and tank cleaning.

BlastClean (https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Gas Detection, Spill Response, 8-Hour Refresher training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour HAZWOPER for crews removing hazardous waste and residues. Enroll: https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Monitoring tanks, pits and vac truck discharge points. Enroll: https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing and responding to spills from hoses, trucks and tanks. Enroll: https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher. Enroll: https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595

## Guides

- [When is industrial cleaning a HAZWOPER job?](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/guides/when-is-industrial-cleaning-hazwoper): Not every cleaning job is a hazardous waste operation. The ones that are, and why clients often require the 40-hour anyway.
- [Vacuum trucks and hazardous materials](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/guides/vacuum-trucks-and-hazardous-materials): Vac trucks pull vapors as well as liquids. The hazards and controls operators need to know.
- [Tank cleaning and confined spaces](https://industrial-cleaning.hazwoperosha.us/guides/tank-cleaning-confined-spaces): Tank entry kills more cleaning workers than any chemical. The essentials of entering safely.
